sentences.en: Then searchers using sonar found six bodies in a span of just two weeks.

sentences.en: Sometimes the searchers wade into the sea, furnished with nets at the end of long poles, by means of which they drag in the sea-weed containing entangled masses of amber; or they dredge from boats in shallow water and rake up amber from between the boulders.
sentences.vi: Đôi khi những người tìm kiếm lội xuống biển, trang bị lưới ở cuối những cây cọc dài, bằng cách họ kéo trong đám cỏ biển có chứa những khối hổ phách vướng víu; hoặc họ nạo vét từ những chiếc thuyền ở vùng nước nông và cào hổ phách từ giữa các tảng đá.

sentences.en: Most are simply search-engine-optimized pages designed to funnel searchers to ad-heavy sites with a few links to outdated but admittedly free games that may or may not work on the latest version of the Palm operating system.

sentences.en: Hair loss support group San Antonio searchers can get in touch with organizations such as the American Hair Loss Association in hopes of obtaining answers or perhaps suggestions regarding a support group in their area.

sentences.en: For jobs in Canadian companies, job searchers can often find a larger assortment of job postings if they use the job search engines which specialize in Canadian job opportunities.
